author: pablocz
body:
https://avicus.net/forums/40a1740c2
Okey, first of all. 

I did got warned. July 1, 2015 at 12:33 AM; Do you really think it took zeusy 48minutes to temban me? July 1, 2015 at 1:15 AM.
No, take a look at my chat log. I reported a guy for team grief. as i reported him he kept going it. zeusy, that guy... instead of taking action, he just went ahead and played for the mean time i msg him he did not respond. look at the chat logs. i got pissed and yes, i told the dude team griefing that he was a retard. the "SrMod" did nothing about it, he instea warned me and Out2Kill.
there was no warn after that situation.
Aren't Staff there to take actions on reports? not just playing as Zeusy does ALL OF THE TIME IM PLAYING AND I REPORT SOMEONE.
he's will just ignore me. well, that's not the point ill talk about that later.
My point is. the warn had nothing to do with the temp ban. and
  • The logs indicate you were incredibly rude.
i just said the word "balls" in chat. everyday in avicus i see people cussing out and mods telling them on public chat to chill, or tokeep it clean, zeusy did none of that.


My point is. Zeus did warn me. Not for the tempban reason. He did not warned me when i was acting "incredibly rude" all i can say is, this server needs to stop giving mod to people, and start kicking the biased mods that are just there to play instead of even making the least effort in taking personal stuff out of a situation like that. That may help. Starting by cleaning the junk of mods that "help" the community, they just make it worst.

This tempban, a week? really? i've never seen a tempban that long. i don't want you guys to ignore me this time. Look at the chat logs. you will see im right, forwardly im in ts and i can fisically explain the situation. 
sorry for bad grammar im not from the states.

title: Innapropriate BehaviorV2.

replies.author: chaibrit1
replies.body:
Hello,

I was in the game at this time. I can recall verbal warning you and a couple other players to stay appropriate. My verbal warn and Zeus' warn should be enough for you to drop your innapropriate behavior, yet you persisted. After checking the logs too, it's blatant that you were being pretty rude as well as adding onto Out2Kill's disrespectful/inappropriate comments. You realized what you were doing wrong so now you'll face the consequences. This appeal is denied.

Regards,

GalaxyBrit
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
